llmEndToEndLatencyScorecard.coverageLimit: Calls without terminal timing are excluded, rather than assigning a fabricated finish time. These are observed-terminal-call latency distributions, not a complete distribution for all started calls.

latencyBreakdown.firstProductiveChunkLimit: Mostly reasoning signals, not first visible answer token; remaining time includes subsequent reasoning/generation, delivery and failed-call idle time, not a measured pure decode duration
latencyBreakdown.causalInterpretation: Both sets used Azure. WHM's much larger input/output workload, different model and high-effort distribution generation are plausible latency drivers. The four logged failures add about3.27s to the observed mean versus successful calls; fallback calls are slower but only6 of108 successes. These observations do not isolate model, effort, context length, generation length, deployment load or transport as a proven causal root; no controlled same-input comparison was run.

providerSpendEstimate.pricing_basis: Global Standard USD list-rate estimate; GPT6.1 input/read/write/output2/.1/2.5/10, GPT6 Sol2/.2/2.5/10 per1M; >272K input doubles input/cache rates and multiplies output by1.5. costCoverage.costFormula: Per completed call: (plain_input*input_rate + cache_reads*cached_rate + cache_writes*write_rate + output*output_rate)/1e6; use long-context rates for input totals above272000 tokens. Sum each actual route separately.
